@echo off
setlocal
set "PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8"
set "PYTHONUTF8=1"
set "PYTHONPATH=%~dp0src"
if not defined FOXERA_IDEAS_HOME if exist "%~dp0..\ideas\" set "FOXERA_IDEAS_HOME=%~dp0..\ideas"
if not defined FOXERA_IDEAS_HOME set "FOXERA_IDEAS_HOME=D:\FoxEra\ideas"
set "PY=python"
where py >nul 2>nul && set "PY=py -3.11"
set "BRANDS=%*"
if "%BRANDS%"=="" set "BRANDS=gerberaprints gritfell kinmireva"
set "LOGD=D:\FoxEra\logs"
set "STATUS=D:\FoxEra\logs\idea_status.log"
if not exist "%LOGD%" mkdir "%LOGD%"
chcp 65001 >nul
set "EXTRA="
if defined TRELLO_KEY if defined TRELLO_TOKEN set "EXTRA=--trello"
set "FAIL=0"
rem idea_job v2 - 07/10/2026. Ban cho Task Scheduler, khong dung lai cho bam phim.
rem 07/10: job chet trong 25 giay, log chi co rc=1, khong co dong idea-pull - khong biet vi sao.
rem Nay: 1 ghi BIEN MOI TRUONG nao co mat - chi ten, KHONG ghi gia tri;
rem 2 moi buoc ghi NGUYEN VAN ra logs\idea_BUOC_BRAND_last.txt, hong thi chep dong cuoi vao status log.
call :envcheck
if defined FOXERA_BRIDGE_URL goto :dopull
>>"%STATUS%" echo %date% %time% ^| idea-pull ^| BO QUA - thieu FOXERA_BRIDGE_URL, dang chay tren ban tin cu
goto :afterpull
:dopull
call :step pull all --pull
:afterpull
for %%B in (%BRANDS%) do call :step scout %%B --scout
for %%B in (%BRANDS%) do call :step idea %%B %EXTRA%
exit /b %FAIL%

:envcheck
set "E=ENV"
if defined ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (set "E=%E% ANTHROPIC=co") else (set "E=%E% ANTHROPIC=KHONG")
if defined TRELLO_KEY (set "E=%E% TRELLO_KEY=co") else (set "E=%E% TRELLO_KEY=KHONG")
if defined TRELLO_TOKEN (set "E=%E% TRELLO_TOKEN=co") else (set "E=%E% TRELLO_TOKEN=KHONG")
if defined FOXERA_BRIDGE_URL (set "E=%E% BRIDGE=co") else (set "E=%E% BRIDGE=KHONG")
>>"%STATUS%" echo %date% %time% ^| %E% ^| user=%USERNAME%
exit /b 0

:step
set "TAG=%1"
set "WHO=%2"
set "OUT=%LOGD%\idea_%TAG%_%WHO%_last.txt"
%PY% -m foxera_core.ideas.run %WHO% %3 %4 > "%OUT%" 2>&1
set "RC=%errorlevel%"
type "%OUT%"
>>"%STATUS%" echo %date% %time% ^| idea-%TAG% %WHO% ^| rc=%RC%
if "%RC%"=="0" exit /b 0
if "%TAG%"=="idea" set "FAIL=1"
powershell -NoProfile -Command "$l = Get-Content -LiteralPath '%OUT%' -Encoding UTF8 | Where-Object { $_.Trim() } | Select-Object -Last 1; Add-Content -LiteralPath '%STATUS%' -Value ('    ly do: ' + $l) -Encoding UTF8"
exit /b 0
